title: Extensions Posted on Approved Referrals and Authorizations
content:
When the requesting or servicing provider asks to extend an approved authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations** of a type that allows extensions, each extension moves the span's last day out and adds days to the authorization.

The days an extension adds are fixed only after the authorization's unit history shows a grant on an initial approval.

## What the extension records

- One extension entry in the authorization's unit history, with its sequence number, the units it adds and the new last day of the validity span.
- The authorization's validity span moves out to that day, and its units remaining rise by the units added.
- Its status, servicing provider and earlier entries are not changed.

## Invocation

The tool is `extend_authorization_stay_203c17fe`. It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `referral_authorization_id` | the reference number of the approved authorization being extended, as returned by the referral and authorization lookup for the patient | identifier, as returned |
| `extension_sequence` | the number of this extension on the authorization: 1 for the first, 2 for the second, and so on | whole number, 0 or more |
| `extended_valid_through` | the new last day of the validity span, inclusive | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `units` | the units the extension adds, in the authorization's own unit of measure | whole number, 0 or more |

## Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `extension_entry_id` (the reference number of the new extension entry), `referral_authorization_id` (the authorization extended), `extension_sequence`, `units_added`, `valid_through` (YYYY-MM-DD, the new last day of the span) and `units_remaining` (after the extension).

## Illustration (hypothetical receipt)

A second extension of an authorization posted with `extension_sequence` 2 returns a receipt whose `extension_sequence` is 2 and whose `units_remaining` is the units remaining before the call plus the units added.
